purpose: Static scope registry for Indian legal citation support. This file documents what CiteJury currently supports, what it deliberately does not claim, and which rules need manual verification.

supportedRules.scope: Supreme Court of India neutral citation token formatting for judgments/orders
supportedRules.confidence: high for token structure; medium for full citation because case names and sequence numbers are user-entered
notCovered: Verification that a sequence number belongs to a specific case

supportedRules.scope: Common core SCC law-report judgment citation component order
supportedRules.format: Case name, (year) volume SCC first page
supportedRules.confidence: medium for core components; low for editorial edge cases

supportedRules.scope: Common core AIR law-report judgment citation component order
supportedRules.format: Case name, AIR year court first page
supportedRules.confidence: medium for core components; low for editorial edge cases
